description: A leave WORD inside a string or template literal in a value-position arm (`"press continue"`, `"please return"`, `` `fail ${…}` ``) is not a leave: the match renders and assigns its value (S462 review F1).
rationale: §18.2 `leave-stmt` is a statement; a string literal containing `continue` is an expression. The leaving-arm refusal decides from parsed statements, never from raw text (one text, one reader).
